paragraphs: Mentioned in [Shabbat 146b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.146b.8), where he disagrees with Rav Ashi and is mentioned first.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rav Yeimar’s explanation before Rav Ashi’s. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2052&lang=en) cites this folio under the form Difta. Neither citation establishes his earliest appearance across the corpus.
